house-calm.name: house-calm
house-calm.thesis: The cloned site's own restraint, kept: cool slate and pale citrine on soft grey, white panels floating with a generous 24px corner.

greenhouse.name: greenhouse
greenhouse.thesis: Clinical-botanical: a warm cream canvas layered with sage and keylime panels, one deep forest ink carrying every heading and every action. Shadowless — depth comes from tinted layers, not elevation.

vitruvian.name: vitruvian
vitruvian.thesis: The body as a drawing. Aged parchment, red-chalk sanguine and sepia ink, squared-off plates with ruled edges — a Renaissance anatomical study rather than a clinic brochure.
